test_title: RRB NTPC - UG 2025 (CBT 2) Mid-Range Full Test - 01
subject: general
question: 4 years ago, the average age of a family of four members was 18 years. A baby is born now, what is the average age of the family when the child will be 8 years old?
solution:
**Given:**

4 years ago, No. of members = 4

4 years ago, Average age of the family = 18 years

Now, No. of members = 5

**Formula:**

Sum of observations = Average × Total no. of observations

**Calculation:**

4 years ago, Total age of the family

⇒ 4 × 18 = 72 years

At present,

Total age of the family
